local screen = script.Parent
local canvas = screen:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("GuiObject")
while not canvas do
    screen.ChildAdded:Wait()
    canvas = screen:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("GuiObject")
end
local scale = canvas:WaitForChild("FigmaScale")
local width = tonumber(script:GetAttribute("DesignWidth"))
local height = tonumber(script:GetAttribute("DesignHeight"))
local offsetX = tonumber(script:GetAttribute("DesignOffsetX"))
local offsetY = tonumber(script:GetAttribute("DesignOffsetY"))
local function resize()
    local size = screen.AbsoluteSize
    local ratio = math.min(size.X / width, size.Y / height)
    scale.Scale = ratio
    canvas.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, offsetX * ratio, 0.5, offsetY * ratio)
end
screen:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(resize)
resize()
